_timing: No narration yet. Each beat is the larger of the time it needs to finish animating and the time it takes to read, plus a 22-frame hold. This is a floor, not considered pacing — measure a real read and switch this topic to voiceCuts.

beats.note: NASA's iconic 1997 Pathfinder image is a composite; a genuine sky exposure stitched to a separately, artistically adjusted foreground.

beats.name: Spirit rover
beats.role: 19 May, Gusev Crater. A real sunset, caught by its Pancam; with a blue glow around the sun.

beats.name: Curiosity rover
beats.role: 15 April, Gale Crater. Captured Mars' first sunset recorded in colour, over six minutes fifty-one seconds.

beats.text: The same dust that turns Martian days red does this.
beats.note: Fine dust in the atmosphere scatters blue light forward, concentrating it near the sun at sunset; the opposite of how Earth's air scatters light.

beats.line: Confirmed by three separate NASA missions, decades apart.
